cases.rationale: Ordinary search is repetitive, contradiction remains, evidence is available, and a plausible cross-domain invariant has positive expected search value.
The target representation already exposes the executable structure; traversal adds cost without expanding the useful frontier.
The main bottleneck is insufficient target evidence. Changing representation cannot manufacture the missing observations.
The candidate transfer is high-risk and weakly supported; capability/competence cannot manufacture authority.
Path-dependent setup cost is already explicit in the target formulation, so structural traversal would mostly rediscover known structure.
Repeated component-level fixes fail under coexistence, indicating a representation bottleneck with strong expected gain from a system/topology representation.
Slow progress alone does not justify traversal when transfer support is weak and false-transfer risk is high.
Cheap imminent measurements can distinguish drift from noise; evidence acquisition dominates representational search.
Despite a real representation signal, decisive missing target evidence could dissolve the contradiction. Evidence should arrive before paying traversal cost.
